managePayments.heading: Payments
managePayments.state.not_connected.title: Not set up
managePayments.state.not_connected.body: Takes about 10 minutes. You will need your bank details and an identity document.
managePayments.state.requirements.title: Stripe needs your details
managePayments.state.requirements.body: Card payments will not work until Stripe has your business details and your bank details.
managePayments.state.pending.title: Connected: Stripe is checking your details
managePayments.state.pending.body: You do not need to do anything. Stripe is reviewing what you sent, and this page will update when it finishes.
managePayments.state.ready.title: Connected
managePayments.state.ready.body: Your Stripe account is connected and can accept payments.
managePayments.state.restricted.title: Card payments paused
managePayments.state.restricted.body: Stripe has paused card payments on your account until an outstanding matter is resolved.
managePayments.state.unsupported.title: This account does not support card payments
managePayments.state.unsupported.body: Stripe cannot enable card payments on this account. Contact us and we will sort it out together.
managePayments.keyMismatch.title: The Stripe keys do not match
managePayments.keyMismatch.body: This website’s server uses the {server, select, live {live} other {test}} Stripe key, while the browser was built with the {browser, select, live {live} other {test}} key. Card payments would fail just as a customer tried to pay, so Stripe setup stays blocked until they match.
managePayments.keyMismatch.fix: Both keys must be set for the same environment, and then the website must be rebuilt: the publishable key is built in at build time and the secret key is read on every request.
managePayments.permission.title: Only the food truck’s owner can set up payments
managePayments.permission.body: Stripe is connected by the person who receives the money in their bank account, so it has to be set up from their own account, logged in. There is no problem with this food truck or with HatchGrab.
managePayments.config.keyMissingTitle: Card payments are not configured yet
managePayments.config.fetchTitle: We could not check this food truck’s Stripe account
managePayments.config.keyMissing: {name} has not been set: the embedded components cannot load.
managePayments.online.heading: Online payments
managePayments.online.body: Customers pay by card when they place the order. The money goes straight to your Stripe account: we never hold it.
managePayments.online.feeLine: Stripe charges {fee} per payment with standard {region}. Other cards may cost more. HatchGrab’s fee on online orders depends on your plan: see Billing.
managePayments.online.testMode: Test mode. Real payments cannot be taken yet.
managePayments.trialNote: Setting it up does not start your subscription or charge you anything today. This is how customers pay you; your plan is a separate thing.
managePayments.admin.title: Platform admin view
managePayments.admin.body: This food truck has not set up online payments. Only the owner can do it, from their own logged-in account: there is nothing to press here.
managePayments.toast.addDetails: Now add your details for Stripe
managePayments.onboarding.restricted: From here Stripe takes over: you will log in to Stripe and update the details it needs.
managePayments.onboarding.firstRun: From here Stripe takes over: you will log in to Stripe and enter your business details and bank details there.
managePayments.details.title: Your Stripe details
managePayments.details.body: Change the bank account where you receive payments, or update your business details and documents.
managePayments.walkUp.heading: Walk-up payments
managePayments.walkUp.body: How you take money at the food truck. HatchGrab charges no platform fee on walk-up orders, whatever you choose.
managePayments.walkUp.ownTerminalHelp: Zettle, Square or whatever you already use. Nothing to set up: only your provider’s fees apply.
managePayments.walkUp.hatchgrabHelp: Uses the same Stripe connection as online payments: a card machine, or contactless payment directly on your phone or tablet.
managePayments.walkUp.hatchgrabFees: {fee} per payment with {region}, plus {surcharge} for contactless payments taken on a phone or a tablet. Other cards may cost more.
manageCharges.heading: Taxes, tips and fees
manageCharges.rate.label: Sales tax rate
manageCharges.rate.hint: The rate you apply to every order. Customers see it added at payment, on receipts and on tickets.
manageCharges.rate.regionDefault: Leave it empty to apply {label} at {rate} %, the rate for prepared food ({region}).
manageCharges.included.label: {label} included in your prices
manageCharges.included.hint: Your prices already include {label}. This rate only shows how much of each price is {label}, on receipts and tickets: nothing is added at payment.
manageCharges.included.default: Leave it empty to use {rate} %, the rate ({label}) for hot takeaway food ({country}).
manageCharges.tips.label: Tips
manageCharges.tips.hint: Customers paying online by card can add a tip. It is all for you.
manageCharges.fee.label: Online service fee
manageCharges.fee.hint: Only added to online orders. Never to “Pay on collection” or walk-up orders. You keep it.
manageCharges.fee.example: Customers see it before paying, in a single line: “{label} {amount}”.
manageCharges.fee.hatchgrab: HatchGrab adds a service fee of {fee} to your customers’ online orders. You do not pay it and cannot change it.
takingPayment.heading: Taking payment
takingPayment.intro: How your team records the money for each order.
takingPayment.paidStepHelp: Adds a “Confirm” button when you add an order yourself, so you can add it now and take payment later. Turn it on if you accept phone or advance orders.
takingPayment.paidStepNote: This only affects the orders you add. It does not affect online orders.

manageWhatsApp.preview.noReplyWhy: It looks like spam, a booking request or something unrelated, so the auto-reply does not answer.
manageWhatsApp.preview.footnote: Replies are generated by AI, vary a little each time and, now and then, may be wrong.
manageWhatsApp.preview.failed: Could not generate a preview right now.
manageWhatsApp.preview.unreachable: Could not connect to the server. Check your connection and try again.

manageWhatsApp.notice.sdkUnavailable: WhatsApp setup is not available in this environment.
manageWhatsApp.notice.sdkBlocked: Meta’s login script could not load. The cause is usually an ad blocker or tracking protection.
manageWhatsApp.notice.setupFailed: Setup could not be completed. Nothing was changed.
manageWhatsApp.notice.metaError: Meta reported a problem during setup. Nothing was changed. Try again and, if it keeps happening, contact us.
manageWhatsApp.notice.closed: Setup was closed before it finished. Nothing was changed: press “Set up” to try again.
manageWhatsApp.notice.disconnectedUnreac: WhatsApp has been disconnected. We could not reach Meta to remove access. Remove HatchGrab in WhatsApp Business → Settings → Account → Business Platform.
manageWhatsApp.notice.disconnected: WhatsApp has been disconnected. Auto-replies have stopped.
manageWhatsApp.card.title: Auto-replies
manageWhatsApp.card.description: Answers customer questions automatically on your social media, based on your menu and your schedule.
manageWhatsApp.card.requiresAccount: A WhatsApp Business account is needed.
manageWhatsApp.card.popupInstruction: A Facebook window will open to connect your WhatsApp Business account. If nothing appears, allow pop-ups for hatchgrab.com in your browser and press “Set up” again.
manageWhatsApp.card.switchedOff: WhatsApp auto-replies are switched off for your food truck.
manageWhatsApp.card.expiring: The WhatsApp connection will need renewing soon. Press “Reconnect” so auto-replies keep working.
manageWhatsApp.card.instagram: Auto-replies to Instagram direct messages. An Instagram professional account will be needed.
manageWhatsApp.card.messenger: Auto-replies on Facebook Messenger. A Facebook Page will be needed.
manageWhatsApp.blocked.title: Your replies are not being delivered
manageWhatsApp.blocked.body: WhatsApp is not sending your automatic replies because of a billing problem on your WhatsApp Business account. Customers can still write to you and you will still see everything they send, but they get no reply.
manageWhatsApp.blocked.fix: You pay WhatsApp directly for these messages, so it is fixed in WhatsApp Manager. <link>Check the payment method</link>
manageWhatsApp.limit.heading: Auto-replies
manageWhatsApp.limit.label: Monthly limit
manageWhatsApp.limit.usage: {used, number} of {limit, number} used · resets on {date}
manageWhatsApp.limit.perCustomer: Maximum replies per customer in 24 hours: {n}. After that, a message is sent saying you will reply personally.
manageWhatsApp.limit.emailAt: Replies stop when you reach the limit. We will email you when you reach 80 % and 100 %.
manageWhatsApp.limit.saved: The monthly reply limit has been saved
manageWhatsApp.billing.heading: Billing
manageWhatsApp.billing.missing: No payment method has been added
manageWhatsApp.billing.summary: Meta, not HatchGrab, bills your WhatsApp account for replies. From {from}, the first {free, number} each month are free. Information current as of {checked}; check <link>Meta’s prices</link> for any changes.
manageWhatsApp.billing.chargesTitle: WhatsApp replies are charged by Meta, not HatchGrab.
manageWhatsApp.billing.chargesBody: Meta bills your WhatsApp Business account for each reply HatchGrab sends for you. From {from}, Meta includes {free, number} free replies a month per number; after that, each reply is charged at Meta’s rate. Replies you send yourself from the WhatsApp Business app are not charged. Meta sets these prices and may change them. <link>See Meta’s prices</link>
manageWhatsApp.billing.addPaymentInManag: Add a payment method in WhatsApp Manager
manageWhatsApp.billing.aboveMissing: Your limit is above Meta’s {free, number} free replies. Without a payment method, Meta will stop all replies once they have been used.
manageWhatsApp.billing.aboveGeneral: Your limit is above Meta’s {free, number} free replies. Replies beyond that number need a payment method on your WhatsApp account; without one, Meta stops all replies when the free ones run out.
manageWhatsApp.disconnect.title: Do you want to disconnect WhatsApp?
manageWhatsApp.disconnect.body: Auto-replies stop immediately and HatchGrab loses access to your WhatsApp account. Your number keeps working in the WhatsApp Business app. To remove HatchGrab completely, also open WhatsApp Business → Settings → Account → Business Platform.
manageWhatsApp.signup.partial: We linked your WhatsApp Business account but could not complete the connection. It is not a problem on your side: contact us and we will finish it.
manageWhatsApp.signup.noNumber: Your WhatsApp Business account is linked, but no phone number came through. Press “Reconnect” and finish the number step.
manageWhatsApp.signup.needsRegistering: Your account is linked, but we have to register this number before replies can start. Contact support: the setup is saved, do not run it again.
manageWhatsApp.signup.registerRefused: Your account is linked, but Meta would not register the number. The setup is saved: contact support instead of running it again.
manageWhatsApp.signup.deliveryRefused: Your account is linked, but Meta would not turn on message delivery. The setup is saved: contact support instead of running it again.
manageWhatsApp.signup.numberTaken: This WhatsApp number is already connected to another HatchGrab account. A number can only answer for one food truck. Contact support and we will move it over.
manageWhatsApp.signup.saveIncomplete: Almost there: we could not finish saving. The setup is saved; contact support instead of running it again.
manageWhatsApp.signup.connected: WhatsApp is connected. Auto-replies will start answering messages that arrive at this number.

customDomain.card.create: We create a page at <addr>{address}</addr> that shows your schedule.

customDomain.waiting.bodySince: You set this up on {date}. New web addresses usually start working within a few minutes and sometimes take up to 24 hours to reach everyone: meanwhile you do not need to do anything. If someone else was to add the line for you, it is worth checking that they did.
customDomain.waiting.body: New web addresses usually start working within a few minutes and sometimes take up to 24 hours to reach everyone: meanwhile you do not need to do anything. If someone else was to add the line for you, it is worth checking that they did.
customDomain.ready.title: {address} is working now
customDomain.ready.body: Have a look at it and then confirm to us in your settings that it is right.
customDomain.confirm.heading: Have a look and confirm to us that it is right
customDomain.confirm.checkTimes: Check that the dates and times are right.
customDomain.confirm.problemLine: Tell us what you see and we will look into it.
customDomain.confirmed.heading: Thank you: we have noted it.
customDomain.confirmed.body: There is nothing more to do.
customDomain.turnOff.heading: Do you want to turn off your own web address?
customDomain.turnOff.carriesOn: This carries on exactly the same, and is where your QR code takes people:
customDomain.turnOff.reAdd: If you will set it up again later, leave the line you added at your web address company. If not, ask them to remove it.
customDomain.turnOff.failed: We could not turn it off right now. Nothing has changed: your address is still working. Try again in a little while.
customDomain.wizard.resumeFailedTitle: We could not load your setup.
customDomain.wizard.resumeFailedBody: Nothing has changed. Try again in a little while.
customDomain.address.intro: Your schedule will get its own web address.
customDomain.address.question: What is your web address?
customDomain.address.hint: The one people already use to find you.
customDomain.address.noChange: Your website does not change: you just add a link to the new address.
customDomain.address.notSetUp: We have not set this up.
customDomain.address.restricted: Whoever manages your web address has to let us set up the padlock, the little padlock customers see next to the address. Until they add us it will not appear, so we have stopped instead of leaving you waiting. Ask them to add us and try again.
customDomain.address.blocked: Right now your web address completely blocks the padlock. Whoever manages it has to allow it for this to work. Ask them to change that and try again.
customDomain.address.elsewhere: This address already answers with something else. Send the message on the next screen to whoever manages it: they will know what to do.
customDomain.address.provider: Your web address is managed by {provider}. We will show you where to go.
customDomain.address.provisionFailed: We could not set up this address.
customDomain.address.couldNotBeSetUp: This address could not be set up.
customDomain.apex.empty: Type the address you want to use.
customDomain.apex.not_a_domain: It does not look like a web address.
customDomain.apex.unparseable: We could not read that as a web address. Check how it is spelt and try again.
customDomain.apex.apex: {host} is the address of your whole website. If you point it at us, this page will replace your website. Put a word in front of it, for example esdeveniments.{host}.
customDomain.apex.too_deep: This address has too many parts. Something like esdeveniments.{domain} works better.
customDomain.record.addSomewhere: Add this where your web address is managed and save.
customDomain.record.hintWord: Only this word, not the whole address.
customDomain.record.timing: It usually starts working in less than an hour, though it can take longer. You do not need to keep this page open.
customDomain.record.someoneElse: Does someone else manage your web address?
customDomain.providers.cloudflare.open: Open your web address and then “DNS” and “Records”.
customDomain.providers.cloudflare.add: Select “Add record” and pick “CNAME” as the “Type”.
customDomain.providers.cloudflare.name: Put the first value below in “Name”.
customDomain.providers.cloudflare.value: Put the second value below in “Target”.
customDomain.providers.cloudflare.proxy: Set “Proxy status” to “DNS only”: the cloud beside it must be grey, not orange.
customDomain.providers.cloudflare.caveat: If the cloud stays orange, the padlock will never appear and nothing will tell you why.
customDomain.providers.godaddy.open: Open your “Domain Portfolio” and choose your web address.
customDomain.providers.godaddy.add: Select “Add New Record” and pick “CNAME” in the “Type” menu.
customDomain.providers.godaddy.name: Put the first value below in “Name”.
customDomain.providers.godaddy.value: Put the second value below in “Value”.
customDomain.providers.godaddy.save: Leave “TTL” as it is and select “Save”.
customDomain.providers.godaddy.caveat: If you added more than one at once, the button says “Save All Records”.
customDomain.providers.123reg.signIn: Log in to your “123 Reg Control Panel”.
customDomain.providers.123reg.manage: Next to “Domains”, select “Manage All” and choose your web address.
customDomain.providers.123reg.name: Put the first value below in “Name”.
customDomain.providers.123reg.value: Put the second value below in “Value” and add a full stop at the end of it.
customDomain.providers.123reg.caveat: 123 Reg needs a full stop at the end of the second value; otherwise it will not work.
customDomain.providers.wix.open: Open “Domains” and click the “Domain Actions” icon next to your web address.
customDomain.providers.wix.add: In the “CNAME (Aliases)” section, click “+ Add Record” and then “Got it”.
customDomain.providers.wix.name: Put the first value below in “Host Name”.
customDomain.providers.wix.value: Put the second value below in “Value”.
customDomain.providers.wix.save: Click “Save” and then “Save Changes” in the pop-up.
customDomain.providers.wix.caveat: If your web address only points at Wix but is not registered there, Wix cannot make this change: whoever has it registered has to.
customDomain.instructionsEmail.subject: One record to add for the schedule page ({truckName})
customDomain.instructionsEmail.introAt: We are putting the live schedule of the food truck {truckName} on {address}, and one record needs adding to our domain at {provider}.
customDomain.instructionsEmail.introHold: We are putting the live schedule of the food truck {truckName} on {address}, and one record needs adding to our domain wherever we have it registered.
